Synopsis:
Player approaches Lae'zel to enjoy a second night of romance, which will be implied offscreen. This could either trigger at the party if the player already slept with Lae'zel, or any other time between her act 1 and 2 romance scenes. To set the feeling of the sexual relationship becoming a regular thing.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Laezel_CRD_SecondNight.json: The scene assumes the PC and Lae'zel have already slept together once off‑screen and the PC is approaching her for a second night of intimacy — this can trigger at the party or any time between her Act 1 and Act 2 romance beats. Lae'zel is still a proud, semi‑hostile githyanki warrior whose feelings are blunt and often expressed in martial terms; she remains focused on her mission and duty even while allowing a private, physical relationship. The tadpole parasite and unfolding late‑game tensions ( Voss/Raphael/hammer/Orpheus threads may be active nearby) influence mood and power dynamics but aren’t shown in this exchange. Overall the lines emphasize sex becoming a recurring, teasingly competitive part of their relationship rather than a single encounter.
- CAMP_Laezel_CRD_AfterRomance2.json: Laezel gets more intimate with the player after their second romance scene.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_SD_SelectNight.json: The scene takes place in camp after the goblin‑hunt celebration when the player elects to sleep; a short narrated sequence plays as you approach your bunk and characters who want you may attempt a nighttime encounter. If Minthara is unpaired she will seek you out and make direct, sensual advances (the narration even frames a mental/physical touch); the player can accept or refuse, and refusal prompts an annoyed retort. Several other camp NPCs are present off‑screen and may have their own topical or reflective lines — some companions (Lae'zel, Astarion) can offer a second overnight scene if you previously romanced them, while others provide only brief reflections (or, in Wyll’s case, have a distinct overnight romance flag). These samples show possible outcomes of that single night but are not exhaustive of every companion’s dialogue.
- CAMP_Laezel_ROM_SD_Romance2_WokenUpByLaezel.json: Laezel wakes you up in the middle of the night, making it seem at first like she wants sex. Instead, she's looking for a way to convince herself that her feelings towards you are justified and you deserve them. She challenges you to single combat.If the player refuses the duel, the romance with Laezel is ended here.If the players accept, they fight in gameplay and regardless of who wins, a sex scene starts afterwards, branching depending on the outcome.
- CAMP_Astarion_CRD_SecondNight.json: Second time Astarion propositions the player to sleep with him - optional CRD between his act 1 and act 2 critical path romance scenes.The player starts to realise Astarion might have been just playing an act to seduce them the whole time, and that his affection for them might not be genuine. Bridges the gap before he confesses this in his act 2 romance, and says he wants to stop manipulating people and have a real relationship.Could either be triggered at the party, or any time before the act 2 scene, as long as you've slept with him before.If player agrees to meet up with Astarion later, it will show them meeting up at the bedroll when the player clicks to rest automatically if it's not at the party, if no other overnight scene is queued. If it's at the party, the player has to choose at the bedroll menu to meet up with him.
